arch_decisions.title: Close watermark-advance-on-silent-drop hole + carry-over review nits
arch_decisions.detail: Whole-branch review of feat/submission-export-emailer found one Critical: (*SMTPEmailSender).SendExport returns nil when the recipient is unset, so SubmissionExportService.ExportNow (backend/internal/services/submission_export.go) treats that as a successful send, advances the watermark, and permanently skips the window's submissions. Fix in two places: (1) ExportNow must refuse to advance the watermark and must return an error when there is data to send but s.cfg.Recipient == ""; (2) backend/cmd/main.go must not start the exporter goroutine at all when the resolved recipient is empty (still build exportCtrl so settings/run-now endpoints respond). Plus a regression test for the new guard, a documentation comment on the wall-clock window assumption, a DB-boundary test for the (from,to] predicate, an API_SPEC.md doc fix to match the actual nested run-now error body, more tolerant enabled-default env parsing via strconv.ParseBool in main.go, and a pure rename of a shadowing loop variable in postgres_export.go. All changes land as one commit on the existing feature branch.

todos.title: ExportNow: hold watermark + refuse send when recipient unset; document window assumption
todos.done_when: In ExportNow, after the empty-window branch (unchanged) and BEFORE building CSV attachments / sending, add: if len(subs)>0 || len(pracs)>0 (i.e. we fell through the empty-window branch) and s.cfg.Recipient == "", return res, fmt.Errorf("submission-export: recipient not configured (set EXPORT_ADMIN_EMAIL or ADMIN_EMAIL); holding watermark") WITHOUT calling AdvanceExportWatermark. Also add a short comment at `end := s.now()` documenting that windowEnd is app wall-clock and the delta assumes submission INSERTs are short single-statement commits (no behavior change, comment only). go build ./... succeeds; fmt import already present, no new imports needed.

todos.title: Gate exporter goroutine on non-empty recipient; robust enabled-default parsing
todos.done_when: Replace the unconditional `go exportSvc.Run(ctx)` with a branch: if exportRecipient == "" log a warning in the existing log style (e.g. 'submission-export: EXPORT_ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_EMAIL unset; exporter loop not started (configure a recipient to enable)') and do NOT start the goroutine; else `go exportSvc.Run(ctx)`. exportCtrl is still built either way. Separately, replace `exportEnabledDefault := os.Getenv(services.ExportEnabledEnv) != "false"` with tolerant parsing: default exportEnabledDefault=true; if the env var is set, parse with strconv.ParseBool and only override the default on a successful parse (parse error keeps default true). Add "strconv" to the import block if not already present. go build ./... succeeds; go vet ./cmd/... clean.

todos.title: Regression test: empty recipient holds watermark and does not send
todos.done_when: Add TestExportNow_EmptyRecipientHoldsWatermark following the file's existing fake/newSvc patterns: a fakeExportRepo with state.Enabled=true and at least one submission row, and a SubmissionExportService built with an ExportConfig{Interval: time.Hour, Recipient: ""} (either add a small local helper or construct via NewSubmissionExportService directly and override s.now, since the existing newSvc hardcodes Recipient:"admin@x.test"). Assert ExportNow returns a non-nil error, sender.calls == 0, and len(repo.advanced) == 0 (watermark not advanced). Must run after TODO-1 lands the guard it exercises. go test ./internal/services/ -run TestExportNow_ -v passes, including this new test.

todos.title: Boundary test for ExportSubmissions (from,to] predicate
todos.done_when: Add a test (new func, or extend TestExportSubmissions_WindowFilter) that plants a row with submitted_at exactly == from (must be excluded: predicate is submitted_at > from) and a row with submitted_at exactly == to (must be included: predicate is submitted_at <= to), using openTestRepo/uniqueUsername and the same per-user filtering the existing test uses (filter returned rows by StudentID==uid) for determinism against a shared DB. File compiles; go test ./internal/repository/ -run TestExportSubmissions -v SKIPs cleanly without TEST_DATABASE_URL (does not fail).

todos.title: API_SPEC.md: correct run-now error body shape
todos.done_when: The `POST /export/run-now` section's 500 line is updated to state the actual nested shape returned by the controller: `{ "error": string, "result": {ExportResult} }` (result is the same object as the 200 body, just with zero/partial fields depending on where the cycle failed), replacing the current 'same body shape plus error' phrasing that implies a flattened body. Controller code (export_controller.go) is NOT touched — doc-only edit.

todos.title: Rename shadowing loop variable in postgres_export.go
todos.done_when: In both ExportSubmissions and ExportPracticeAttempts, the loop-local `var r models.SubmissionExportRow` / `var r models.PracticeAttemptExportRow` (which shadows the `r *PostgresRepository` receiver) is renamed to `row`, along with its rows.Scan(&row....) and append(out, row) usages. Pure rename, no behavior change. go build ./... succeeds.

agent_notes.merge: clean — reviewed 6 files across 5 parallel groups (main.go, submission_export.go, submission_export_test.go, postgres_export.go, postgres_export_query_test.go, API_SPEC.md). No file touched by more than one group, no duplicate/conflicting logic, no drive-by edits outside file_scope. main.go's exportRecipient gating (skip starting the Run() goroutine when empty, but still build exportCtrl) is consistent with submission_export.go's new ExportNow guard (returns error + holds watermark when Recipient=="" and there is data), so run-now with an empty recipient now surfaces the error via exportCtrl instead of silently succeeding. postgres_export.go's r->row rename touches only the two loop-locals; the `r *PostgresRepository` receiver and its r.pool.* call sites elsewhere in the file are untouched, so it compiles cleanly with no other file referencing those loop-locals. go build ./..., go vet ./..., and go test ./internal/services/ -run TestExportNow_ -v (5/5 pass) all clean; go test ./internal/repository/ -run TestExportSubmissions (2/2 SKIP without TEST_DATABASE_URL, as required). Note: TODO.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-01-auth-password-management-design.md also show uncommitted diffs in the working tree, but neither is in any of TODO-1..6's file_scope and their content (submission_queue.go race fix dated 2026-07-11, OTP forgot-password amendment dated 2026-07-02) is unrelated to this ARCH-001 batch — pre-existing uncommitted work from a prior session, not a drive-by edit by these 5 implementor instances. No action needed from merge-check.
